reason: The README clearly describes a web-search and URL-content extraction plugin that provides multi-provider search fallback and configurable external search integrations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多引擎网页搜索、搜索结果正文提取以及可配置的外部搜索服务接入。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with multi-engine web search, readable URL content extraction, and configurable external search service integrations.

capabilities: Performs web searches through configurable search providers
Fetches URLs and extracts readable text from HTML pages
Uses configured SearXNG, Tavily, and Brave service credentials
Falls back to DuckDuckGo when configured providers are unavailable
